corrections.duplicateIdentity: Intentional. The PZO9269 seed and the #280 record hold the same text under different identities. Promoting the seed is left unapplied: the coordinator kept Occult Mysteries unchanged, and duplicate Registry identities are reconciled under #737.

holds.title: Ultimate Combat (pf1-content compilation lines 478-479)
holds.reason: Both pf1-content Ultimate Combat lines carry Ultimate Magic's author list (OGL.txt:484; PRD line 385); Paizo's PRD line 387 gives Ultimate Combat's own authors. #224 and #227 record the defect. The lines stay in the verbatim upstream block and their #293 records are unchanged, but they can never stand as Ultimate Combat's notice. This dedicated hold keeps the defect enforced if the complete-chain holds that also name them ever clear.
